description: This file defines the interface for the IClientController and its accessor within the Rialto client namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures for managing shared memory and client registration, and references to external classes like IControlClient and ISharedMemoryHandle.

classes.name: IClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of IClientController and a method to retrieve the controller.

classes.name: IClientController
classes.description: Defines the internal API for managing shared memory and client registration within the Rialto client.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IClientControllerAccessor.

methods.name: getClientController
methods.description: Returns a reference to the IClientController singleton object.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client and provides the current application state.
